description:
Get significant adverse drug reactions from OpenFDA data.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table openfda_significant_adverse_drug_reactions — one record = one FAERS adverse event significantly reported for one drug.
Key: chembl_id, event.
Arguments: drug_id accepts chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by llr desc, then event asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. openFDA FAERS events with llr above the drug's critical value; absence means not significant or not reported.

drug_id.description: Accepts chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one chembl_molecule (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
